title.narrative: Disaggregated Number of stakeholders engaged in EU and China

description.narrative: Precise definition:By Stakeholders engaged the project understands the authorities, research, technical and academic institutions, NGOs / civil society organisations, business representatives and individual experts in China, Europe and beyond taking part in the projects multiple activities, from consultations with the KE to participants or attendants in events, workshops, authors of studies, etc. As number the project understands the different institutions / organisations involved, even if participants lists in events will include individual participants.

comment.narrative: 10 different stakeholders engaged i.e. participants from 10 different authorities institutions or organisations in EU andor China.
